head: MediateMe helps you explain yourself in tricky conversations
dek: MediateMe is a calm, turn-based app that gives a bottom-line analysis of a disagreement and suggests messages tailored to how the other person thinks. It was #9 among paid Business apps on the US App Store on 7 November.
details: It came out on 5 November and costs $2.99, by Tesia Watkins.
means: If you keep re-explaining the same point by text, it helps you word it differently.
todo: Find MediateMe in the App Store.
thumb_words: SAY IT SO THEY GET IT
